tei:bibl.tei:title: Differences from the 1822 Heidenheim original
tei:bibl.tei:note: (1) Biblical quotations in this edition were taken from the Westminster Leningrad Codex (WLC), not from the printed 1822 haggadah text. (2) The original edition's ritual instructions, partly in German (in Hebrew characters) and partly in Hebrew, are not transcribed in the Hebrew project; English instructions appear only in the separate Feinstein translation project. (3) Heidenheim's edition notes and commentary are omitted. (4) The Ashkenazi German translation that accompanied the original Hebrew is not included. (5) Typography and layout follow modern digital conventions; tei:pb milestones mark page breaks in the 1822 print when a reference PDF is available. (6) Pre-seder material (bedikat chametz, biur chametz, eruv tavshilin) follows the Open Siddur compilation and may differ in scope or placement from the 1822 book. (7) Vocalization and spelling follow the Open Siddur transcription, not 1822 printing conventions. Further wording and paragraphing differences may be documented during PDF alignment.
